entries.title: Public funds, public safety (scoping review)
entries.key_finding: Evidence corpus spans BOTH books: social-welfare/health/education spending (proactive) AND law-enforcement spending (reactive) each n=8-21 of 33 studies - but reviews them side-by-side with NO two-book/timing-of-dollar framework.

summary: Novelty verdict summary (PAIRING-3): Both halves of the two-book model are VERIFIED: proactive (Heckman RCT canon 2014/2019/2023, CTC benefit-cost 2021, Lancet adolescent ROI 2017) and reactive (WSIPP-ledger MST-CAN $3.31-per-$1 2018; Peace Management Initiative cost-effectiveness 2018; Chalfin police-force elasticity under pairing-1). EXTENSIONS exist connecting proactive spending to firearm homicide specifically (Lind 2024). The explicit TWO-BOOK TIMING model - proactive vs reactive subsidy dollars distinguished by WHEN they land relative to violence, with different books/ledgers - was not found as a named framework: Lund 2025 reviews both spending types without any timing or ledger split. => two-book model = NOVEL-ANGLE (components VERIFIED, the combined timing/ledger architecture = GAP-adjacent).
